description.purpose: The display cell: it binds params.port, holds the object tree and the component library in its own cell.db, renders server-side into a materialised LiveView tree and pushes exactly one diff per applied write to whoever is looking at the affected page.
description.use_when: One instance per display. The port is required and owned -- give a second instance its own via override_params. The default bind is loopback because this cell type never authenticates and never will (R-W8-2).
description.not_in_scope: No auth, no TLS, no routing of its own (the pages table is the only route source; there is no cell.surface key any more -- it was removed with the /surface/* path it declared, and a tree still carrying one is refused at boot by name), no application logic. It renders what it was sent and reports what a person did.
description.emits_meaning: Three emission shapes, hence no required hop key: (a) a tool_result reply per op -- hop carries operation, rows_affected, duration_ms and error_code when the op was refused; (b) a bundle reply for two or more tool_call turns -- hop.operation is 'bundle', rows_affected is the sum, and bundle_errors is stamped unconditionally, 0 included, while the body carries a results[] slot with one metadata entry per leg in call order; (c) a semantic browser event as a SOURCE emission on hop.route 'event' -- header event_name, session_id (the page load's own id) and page_route, body carrying the event slot beside the turn. Promoting session_id into context.session_id is the entry edge's set_context job, exactly as with the proxy cell.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: tool_call turns carrying the ops. One turn is a single operation, two or more are a bundle -- tool_call TURNS are counted, so prose beside a call does not change how the call is answered.
examples: object.create {parent: 'root', component: 'text', props: {body: 'hello'}} -> one tool_result, one diff to every viewer of the page that contains 'root'
a button press in the browser -> a source emission with hop {route: 'event', event_name: 'action', session_id, page_route: '/'}
